protocol.numericTolerance: 1e-9 * max(1, abs(a), abs(b)); other types and error codes exact
protocol.timed: Session construction and synchronous edits including their returned changes. Input generation/conversion, formatting, result extraction, verification and hashes excluded.
protocol.isolation: One sequential child process per workload and engine; explicit GC before each fresh session. HF 3.5.0 defaults to AlwaysDense. Column index is tested separately on lookup; AlwaysSparse and automatic mapping (threshold 0.5) separately on the sparse book. The 34000-row HF business case is a single bounded cold probe.

workloads.title: 2000 cells in a roughly 97000 x 311 sheet
